pages.text: Fusion Fuel Aggregator: converts 1 activated component into 1,000 mb of plasma, costing 2,000 energy and 100 ticks.$(br2)Output plasma is determined by the component:$(li)$(bold)Mixed Plasma$(reset): World Base, Advanced Mixture or Ultimate Mixture components$(li)$(bold)Nether Plasma$(reset): Nether Compound or Pure components$(li)$(bold)End Plasma$(reset): End Mixture or Dragon components$(br2)The three kinds should be stored in separate tanks.

$(bold)Piping:$(reset) plasma travels only through Plasma Pipes and Plasma Fuel Tanks; ordinary fluid pipes reject it. The dedicated line between this machine and the $(l:akaishi:plasma_filler)Plasma Filler$(/l) must be laid first.$(br2)Filled rods are used in the $(l:akaishi:fusion)Fusion Reactor$(/l); the temper of each rod is compared in $(l:akaishi:plasma_rods)Plasma Fuel Rods$(/l).

Feedstock comes from the $(l:akaishi:plasma_fractionator)Activated Fractionator$(/l) and output goes to the $(l:akaishi:plasma_filler)Plasma Filler$(/l); the chain overview is in $(l:akaishi:plasma)Plasma Chain$(/l).
